ISESSION::deduplication
       Allows selection of deduplication based on L7 content inspection.

SYNOPSIS
       ISESSION::deduplication BOOL_VALUE

DESCRIPTION
       Allows selection of deduplication based on L7 content inspection

       Syntax

       ISESSION::deduplication enable|disable

	    * Allows selection of deduplication based on L7 content inspection

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
